_comment: 露脸模式规则：① 每个角色一条不同的 face token（≥60 字，逐字节复用）；② 同一角色的所有镜头都照抄它；③ 不同角色的 token 不许雷同。五名失踪儿童不在本表内，全片不给任何孩子面容 token。改完跑：python3 production/face_cast.py check-prompts --project production/frogboy1991
_casting_note: 五个角色都是符合年代的虚构匿名成年人（AI 生成），不是任何真实人物的容貌还原。五名失踪儿童（金永奎、赵浩延、金钟植、朴灿仁、禹哲元）全片不露正脸，只以背影、剪影、远景和服装物件出现，不给任何面容 token。

characters.name: 母亲（虚构匿名角色，非真人容貌）
characters.face: an anonymous South Korean woman of forty-one: a soft oval face with gentle full cheeks, kind dark eyes with faint lines at the corners, arched brows, a small straight nose, a calm mouth with natural pink lips, short permed dark-brown hair just above the shoulders with a few loose strands, warm light skin; she wears a plain cream cardigan over a floral blouse.

characters.name: 父亲（虚构匿名角色，非真人容貌）
characters.face: an anonymous South Korean man of forty-five: a broad weathered face with deep forehead creases, tired brown eyes with heavy lids, thick dark eyebrows slightly greying, a wide flat nose, a firm mouth with downturned corners, short black hair combed back from a receding hairline, stubble along the jaw, tanned skin; he wears a dark zip jacket over a plain grey shirt.

characters.name: 刑警（虚构匿名角色，非真人容貌）
characters.face: an anonymous South Korean man of fifty: a square face with a heavy jaw and strong cheekbones, narrow determined eyes under low straight brows, a straight nose, thin lips pressed together, short greying crew-cut hair, clean-shaven skin with a few age lines; he wears a plain dark jacket over a white shirt with a slim tie.

characters.name: 法医与分析员（虚构匿名角色，非真人容貌）
characters.face: an anonymous South Korean woman of thirty-eight: an oval face with a straight jaw and neat regular features, calm focused almond eyes behind thin rimless glasses, straight dark eyebrows, a small straight nose, unpainted lips, black hair pulled back into a tidy low bun, clear even skin; she wears a white lab coat over a dark turtleneck.

characters.name: 老邻居（虚构匿名角色，非真人容貌）
characters.face: an anonymous South Korean woman of sixty-eight: a round kind face with soft wrinkles around the eyes and mouth, gentle squinting dark eyes, thin greying eyebrows, a small round nose, a warm smile with few teeth showing, short grey permed hair, rosy cheeks; she wears a dark cardigan over a faded flowered blouse.

characters.name: 山间村民（虚构匿名角色，非真人容貌）
characters.face: an anonymous South Korean man of fifty-six: a lean narrow face with sunken cheeks, a thin grey moustache, deep-set tired eyes, a high forehead with thinning grey hair combed back, a thin closed mouth, and weathered brown skin; he wears a faded olive work jacket over a grey shirt and a knitted cap pushed slightly back.
